summary: Iter-76 (backend + quick frontend): Refund Webhook Sync — verified apply_cashfree_refund_status + _confirm_refund_credit + poll_cashfree_refund_status + /scheduler/trigger/cashfree-refund-sync + Cashfree /payments/cashfree/webhook (signed HMAC) end-to-end. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter76_refund_webhook_sync.py (11 tests) — 11/11 PASS. Frontend: logged in support user, /support → Refunds tab renders 4 Credited (sky) badges + Credited filter pill works; no initiated-unconfirmed refund currently exists in DB so 'Refund Initiated' (indigo) badge is not visually observed live, but JS isCredited/isInitiated helpers directly mirror backend refund_credit_status logic (verified by Scenario B where webhook sync of first-of-two txns leaves refund_credit_status unset).
critical_code_review_comments: apply_cashfree_refund_status L582-607 correctly matches on either gateway_refund_id OR merchant_refund_id (webhook sometimes carries only one), no-op when gateway_status already equals incoming status (idempotent short-circuit at L593), and stamps status_source+status_synced_at. Solid.

_confirm_refund_credit L544-579 gate on unresolved cashfree txns (count_documents where gateway_status != SUCCESS) → only when zero pending, updates refund_credit_status=SUCCESS, refund_credited_at, gateway_refund_status=SUCCESS, propagates refund_status='credited' to inquiries/bookings/vertical_bookings, sends email, writes signed audit_logs refund_credited. Guard at L551 prevents duplicate email/audit on replay (test A confirmed cnt==1 after two applies).
poll_cashfree_refund_status L610-628 correctly filters gateway_status NOT IN [SUCCESS, CANCELLED, FAILED], so already-final txns are never re-polled (test D verified via stub call log).

cashfree_routes.py L756 event_key now includes cf_payment_id OR refund_uid → different refund ids on same order are NOT deduped against each other (test F verified: cfr_T5 and cfr_T5_alt both processed, resulting request refund_credit_status=SUCCESS only after both).
/refunds/failed-gateway L402-406 $or query correctly surfaces (a) refunds without gateway_refund_id and (b) refunds later CANCELLED/FAILED/ONHOLD by Cashfree. Test C verified CANCELLED path appears.
/refunds/my L323-359 gateway-aware credited logic + 'Refund initiated — bank credit within 5–7 business days' sub for initiated-but-unconfirmed cashfree requests (test G verified).

MINOR (non-blocking): sync_cashfree_refund_credits/scheduler + trigger endpoint returns 200 with real Cashfree GETs to fake orders; each GET call is a real network hit — poller runs every 30 min and hits real API per pending txn (no rate limit guard). For scale, consider batching by order or short-circuiting on 404. Not a defect for current volume.

MINOR (non-blocking): _confirm_refund_credit writes gateway_refund_status='SUCCESS' but _refund_via_cashfree writes 'processed' — two different string states for the same conceptual field. /failed-gateway relies on absence of gateway_refund_id OR CANCELLED/FAILED/ONHOLD in refund_credit_status, so it works, but downstream UI/analytics reading gateway_refund_status must handle both. Suggest documenting the state machine.
